gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient admitted to neurosurgery department for surgical resection of a suspected grade 3 or 4 glioma with 5-ALA (cases)

candidate_evidence.quote: HIVEN Medical Device: A medical device (HIVEN®) detects 5-ALA-induced fluorescence from the surgical suction and gives sound feedback to the operating surgeon indicating tumor tissue

role_evidence.quote: The 5-ALA (Gleolan, NX Development Corp) has been already FDA-approved since 2017 for fluorescence-guided resection of suspected WHO grade 3 or 4 gliomas.

coder_notes: Device (HIVEN) usability study; 5-ALA is not a registered intervention but is the premise of the fluorescence signal, so listed for transparency as diagnostic_agent. Glioblastoma not named anywhere; only suspected grade 3 or 4 glioma and brain neoplasms. Arm is a single OTHER arm labelled 'Usability Assessment'.
